title: Ayanis andesite foundation under mud brick

tellings.quote: that's the foundation of ionas okay you're looking at now that is built out of an aite one of the hardest stones on Earth

plain: At Ayanis, an ancient site in Turkey, mud-brick walls are said to sit on a foundation of andesite, "one of the hardest stones on Earth," as if the later builders reused the work of someone older and more skilled. The researcher Matt LaCroix shows this to Michels without naming a source: "that's the foundation of Ayanis... built out of andesite." If true, it would point to a lost earlier culture beneath known ones.
